name: Valley of Elah

related_people.name: Abinadab
related_people.role: David's brother, serving in Saul's army here during the standoff with Goliath

related_people.name: Eliab
related_people.role: David's eldest brother, who rebuked him for coming to the battle line here

related_people.name: Goliath
related_people.role: defied Israel's army in this valley for forty days until David killed him

description: The valley where the Israelite and Philistine armies camped on opposite hillsides while Goliath issued his daily challenge, and where the shepherd boy David killed him with a sling and stone (1 Samuel 17).
